This cannot be undone

Deleting your account permanently removes your entire store, including its products, staff accounts, and complete transaction history. There is no way to recover it afterward.

What gets deleted:

  • Your store profile and settings
  • All products, categories and ingredients
  • All staff accounts and PINs
  • Your complete sales and transaction history
  • Payment methods and receipt settings

Submitting this sends a confirmation link to your account's email — nothing is deleted until you click it. The link expires in 1 hour. If you don't see it, check spam, or email us directly at merq@prohubapps.com.
